notes.title: Update 0.1.7
notes.content:
Hi everyone !

Based on your feedbacks, we launch the update 0.1.7.
What changes ?
So :
-We added a "Sell all" button, you don't have to enter an amount anymore.
-The IdleCoin price is less variable to the up (too easy before...)
-Upgrades are now effective at 25% !

Thanks to every players and the community !
We'll be back soon.

BovinoSoftware.
